facts.rationale: Resolved to supported (T2 only, moderate confidence): Lonely Planet says to hike up to Chhorkhung saddle to reach the centre, and Outlook Traveller's Namche article puts the museum 'atop an elevated location'. No T1 source contradicts.

Resolved to unverifiable: natural history and Sherpa culture are backed (Lonely Planet: 'Himalayan flora and fauna and the culture of the Khumbu Sherpas'), but 'history of mountaineering in the Himalaya' as exhibit content has no reliable source.
